doc: Selects a frame via func_800489F4(a0,a1,a2), dispatches via func_80048998(a0,a3), then divides the newly-selected frame's leading u16 field by the global byte divisor D_80080A84[0], storing the quotient into obj offset 0x5 and clearing bits 0x6000 of obj's u16 field at offset 0x14.

globals.name: D_80080A84
globals.decl: extern u8 D_80080A84[16]; /* accessed as a single byte D_80080A84[0]; must be declared size>8 so gcc addresses it via %hi/%lo (lui+lbu) rather than $gp-relative, matching retail's lui %hi(D_80080A84)/lbu %lo(D_80080A84)($v0) sequence */
